title: Scale-robust Auctions
abstract: arXiv:2510.21231v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study auctions that are robust at any scale, i.e., they can be applied to sell both expensive and cheap items and achieve the best multiplicative approximation of the optimal revenue in the worst case. We first show that it is without loss of optimality to restrict attention to scale-invariant mechanisms whenever the family of possible distributions is closed under every positive rescaling. This conclusion uses no regularity or other distributional shape restriction. We then solve the two-agent, single-item problem with values drawn i.i.d. from an unknown regular distribution when only a high value bidder can receive a positive allocation. The robustly optimal mechanism in this class randomizes between the second-price auction, with probability approximately 0.806, and a markup auction that offers the item to the highest-valued bidder at a price equal to 2.447 times the second-highest value. translated_abstract: 我们研究在任何规模下都稳健的拍卖，即它们既可以用于出售昂贵的商品，也可以用于出售廉价的商品，并在最坏情况下实现对最优收益的最佳乘法近似。我们首先证明，只要可能的分布族在每个正数缩放下都是封闭的，那么将注意力限制在尺度不变机制上不会损失最优性，且这一结论不依赖任何正则性或其他分布形状限制。随后我们求解了两个代理人、单件商品的拍卖问题，其中投标人的估值独立同分布地来自一个未知的正则分布，且只有高估值投标人才能获得正的分配概率。该问题中稳健最优的机制在二级价格拍卖（概率约为0.806）与加价拍卖之间随机化，后者以等于次高估值2.447倍的价格将商品提供给最高估值的投标人。其最坏情况下的近似比……
tldr: 该论文研究在任何规模下都稳健的拍卖机制，证明在分布族对正数缩放封闭时可不失一般性地只考虑尺度不变机制，并求解出两人单商品问题的稳健最优机制：以约0.806的概率运行二级价格拍卖，否则以2.447倍次高估值的价格向最高估值者出售商品。
en_tdlr: This paper studies scale-robust auctions, proves that restricting to scale-invariant mechanisms is without loss of optimality when the distribution family is closed under positive rescaling, and solves the two-agent single-item problem with a robustly optimal mechanism that randomizes between the second-price auction (probability ≈0.806) and a 2.447× markup auction.
